description.value: A classic Okanagan resort on safe, shallow Tuc-el-Nuit Lake with a 500-foot private beach and shaded full hook-up RV campsites; situated in Oliver's wine country with dozens of rideable winery destinations nearby, though all listed sites are full hook-up RV pads with no tent-specific pitches mentioned.

address.value: 6707 Lakeside Drive, Oliver, BC V0H 1T4, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at thelakesideresort.com fully loaded and provides rich evidence. Key passages: 28+37 full hook-up RV/campsites with 'power, water and sewer'; navigation explicitly lists 'Library, Store, Ice Laundry and Hot Tub'; the About Us page explicitly references 'Steak-on-the-Lake golf/cycling/wine-touring planning services' and cycling getaways; phone 250-498-2177 is consistent across multiple pages. OSM carries no street address or phone, so those fields are sourced from the website. No street address appears anywhere in the website text.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number or street address; phone 250-498-2177 is sourced from the website only.
No civic street address found anywhere in the website content; address field cannot be populated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, actively operating resort on Tuc-el-Nuit Lake in Oliver that explicitly markets cycling/wine-touring packages to touring cyclists; full hook-up sites, laundry, ice, covered shelter, and on-site reservations make it a strong listing for the South Okanagan corridor.
